decisions.reason: The Champions UI already uses repository-approved compact 'Uma'; replacing the inconsistent 'Umamusume' spelling improves terminology consistency and reduces width without changing the pillar/core-member meaning.
The participation-count label is natural, very compact, and well within the tiny UI budget.
The win-rate label is already standard Vietnamese and extremely compact.
The Top-2 rate label is concise and fits easily; no substantive UI issue is present.
The cumulative-record heading is semantically precise and remains within the compact budget; shortening it would be stylistic rather than necessary.
The data-analysis heading is standard, natural, and compact.
Capitalizing 'Top' matches the adjacent reviewed/statistical Top-2 label and removes a visible terminology-style inconsistency without affecting width or meaning.
The compact record format preserves both placeholders and is already appropriate for a small statistics control.
The ranked-league heading is clear and compact enough; there is no evidence that a shorter wording would be more accurate.
The training-rank label is concise and fits comfortably within a tiny/compact control.
The league-participation button is direct, natural, and compact.
Within the league-selection screen the object being selected is already explicit; the shorter label preserves the selection-period meaning and the trailing delimiter while reducing redundant wording.
The two-line participation condition is clear, preserves {0} and the source newline, and fits within the normal compact budget.
The league-selection action is direct and comfortably within the compact budget.
The league-selection confirmation title is natural and remains inside the compact hard budget; shortening is not necessary.
The participation-reward heading is semantically complete and within the normal compact budget.

This matches the already-reviewed Champions countdown pattern, preserves all three formatted placeholders exactly, and replaces the wider formal 'đến khi khai cuộc' tail with the compact race-time wording.
The direct button verb 'Đổi' preserves the league-change action and is more appropriate for a fixed control than the wider nominal phrase 'Thay đổi'.
Existing reviewed Champions selection UI removes polite filler and uses canonical compact 'Uma'; the screen already makes the selection purpose clear.
The current-group label is natural and very compact.
